10k.error: Foreign private issuer — Prenetics Global Ltd is incorporated in the Cayman Islands and headquartered in Hong Kong; it files Form 20-F with the SEC, not Form 10-K.

website.error: No drug clinical pipeline page — issuer is a consumer/clinical genomics and diagnostics company (DNA testing, early cancer detection diagnostics, COVID-era testing legacy).

ctgov.note: ClinicalTrials.gov shows a small number of Prenetics-sponsored studies, none of which are interventional drug trials in Phase 1/2/3. Studies are diagnostic/observational in nature (e.g. genomic testing, screening).

commercial_product.note: Prenetics operates in consumer and clinical genomic testing (Circle DNA), early cancer detection diagnostics (via its ColoClear / IM8 / ACT Genomics-related product lines and partnerships), and previously high-throughput diagnostic testing services. These are diagnostics and consumer health products, not therapeutic assets.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Prenetics Global is a genomics and diagnostics company (consumer DNA testing, early cancer detection, clinical lab services), not a drug developer.
